result.explanation: Tracks available rights, spent totals, received grants, permanently recorded sends/spends, and currently pending sends. Receive, send, and spend identities are separate. Accepted sends/spends debit immediately; cancellation refunds a pending send, while acknowledgment only removes pending status. Outputs sort identifiers by Unicode code point order.
result.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(s===null)s={a:c.initial,sp:0,r:[],se:[],pe:[],ss:[]};function find(a,id){for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][0]===id)return a[i];return null}function has(a,id){return a.indexOf(id)>=0}function cmp(a,b){var i=0,n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);while(i<n){var x=a.codePointAt(i),y=b.codePointAt(i);if(x!==y)return x-y;i++}return a.length-b.length}var t=e&&e.type,id=e&&e.id,amt=e&&e.amount,st='ignored',ok=typeof id==='string';if(t==='receive'){if(!ok||typeof amt!=='number'||!Number.isSafeInteger(amt)||amt<=0||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c.grants,id)||c.grants[id]!==amt)st='invalid';else if(has(s.r,id))st='duplicate';else{s.r.push(id);s.a+=amt;st='accepted'}}else if(t==='send'||t==='spend'){var a=t==='send'?s.se:s.ss,o=find(a,id);if(!ok||typeof amt!=='number'||!Number.isSafeInteger(amt)||amt<=0)st='invalid';else if(o)st=o[1]===amt?'duplicate':'conflict';else if(s.a<amt)st='insufficient';else{a.push([id,amt]);s.a-=amt;if(t==='send')s.pe.push([id,amt]);else s.sp+=amt;st='accepted'}}else if(t==='ack'||t==='cancel'){if(ok){var p=find(s.pe,id);if(p){s.pe.splice(s.pe.indexOf(p),1);if(t==='cancel')s.a+=p[1]}}}else st='invalid';return{state:s,output:{status:st,available:s.a,spent:s.sp,pending:s.pe.map(function(v){return v[0]}).sort(cmp),received:s.r.slice().sort(cmp)}}}
